page_title: Cadran · Clock Wallpaper for Mac · Mac Wallpaper Clock App

sources.entry: Cadran - Renders 22 customizable clock faces on your Mac desktop wallpaper and screensaver.

summary.name: Cadran
summary.one_liner: Cadran is a macOS clock wallpaper app that draws live clock faces on the desktop wallpaper layer behind your icons, across all Spaces and displays.
use_cases: Show a clock on the Mac desktop behind icons
Replace desktop widgets with a wallpaper clock
Display a clock screensaver on Mac
Show weather or moon phase on the desktop
Customize desktop clock on multiple monitors
summary.what_it_does: Cadran renders clock faces on the macOS wallpaper layer, behind desktop icons, and shows them on every Space and display without using windows or widgets. The page says there are 22 faces across six categories (Numeric, Analog, Data, Abstract, Matrix, Spectrum). Users pick a face and a background preset, or use transparent mode to keep their own wallpaper. Optional complications overlay data such as weather, date, battery and moon phase on supported faces, with weather powered by Apple WeatherKit. Control is through a menu bar item, and the app can hide the Dock icon and seconds hand.
notable: Renders on the wallpaper layer behind icons, across every Space and display, with screensaver mode
Free tier with 6 faces; one-time $9.99 Pro unlock with no subscription
Privacy-focused: no accounts or analytics SDKs, preferences stored locally
Clock text available in eight languages including Japanese, Korean and Brazilian Portuguese
caveats: Most premium faces, advanced complications, move and resize, and per-display setup require the $9.99 Pro purchase
Pro license covers up to 3 Macs
A user review asks for custom fonts and a custom text message, which the page does not list as features
